headline.summary: Lab data: 16 of 88 measurements are over budget across 4 of the 5 pages. The worst: LCP on the home page is 10.3 s on mobile-mid, set by a 1.8 MB hero image that regressed from 2.2 s in release 1.0; Add to basket takes 2.8 s to respond on mobile-mid; analytics.js blocks the menu pages for about 4 s. /about is within budget on both profiles. Field performance not established.

findings.title: analytics.js blocks the main thread on /menu, /menu/breads
findings.cause: long tasks in /js/analytics.js (4030.5 ms of script)
findings.remediation: /js/analytics.js runs about 4030.5 ms of script in one long task after load on mobile-mid (4x CPU), and coverage shows almost all of its 391 KB is never executed. Defer or lazy-load it after the first interaction, split the work into chunks under 50 ms, and drop the unused code.
findings.verification_step: Rerun the plan for the menu template: TBT should be under 300 ms (mobile) and 200 ms (desktop).

findings.title: The LCP image on / takes 10.3 s on mobile-mid
findings.remediation: The LCP element is html>body>main>img.hero, 1855 KB of PNG with no fetchpriority and no width/height attributes; 10.1 s of the LCP time is the download itself. Serve a resized, compressed image (AVIF or WebP, srcset for the 364 px rendered width on mobile), add fetchpriority="high" and width/height. The same file is most of the page weight (the transfer_total finding has the same cause).
findings.verification_step: Rerun the plan for /: the mobile-mid LCP median should fall below 2.5 s and the LCP resource below 200 KB.

findings.title: Add to basket takes 2.8 s to respond on mobile-mid
findings.cause: pointer on #add: 2790 ms processing in BUTTON#add.onclick
findings.remediation: pointer on #add: 2790 ms of processing in BUTTON#add.onclick, with almost no input or presentation delay, so the handler itself is the cause (it recalculates the whole basket on every click). Update the basket incrementally, or move the work off the main thread and update the button first. This is the ordering page, a critical path.
findings.verification_step: Rerun the plan for /order: INP should be under 200 ms on both profiles.

findings.title: The menu pages wait 450.4 ms for the server
findings.remediation: Server-Timing attributes 450.4 ms of each response to db (the menu query); every other step is under 1 ms. Cache the menu, or index the query. Read from the responses' own headers; no extra requests were sent.
findings.verification_step: Rerun the plan for the menu template: TTFB under 300 ms on desktop, and Server-Timing db under 50 ms.

findings.title: /js/analytics.js is over the JavaScript budget on /menu, /menu/breads
findings.cause: largest download /js/analytics.js (391 KB script, 390 KB unused)
findings.remediation: 391 KB of script against 391 KB, and the diagnostic run's coverage shows 390 KB of it unused. Removing the dead code fixes this and most of the long task.
findings.verification_step: Rerun the plan for the menu template: transfer_script under 391 KB on mobile-mid.

findings.title: / transfers 1.87 MB on mobile-mid
findings.remediation: /img/hero.png alone is 1855 KB of the total; the fix for the LCP image also brings the page under budget.
findings.verification_step: Rerun the plan for /: transfer_total should be under 1562 KB on mobile-mid.

findings.title: A late banner shifts the content of / (CLS 0.131)
findings.remediation: The shift (0.131 at 1609 ms moving main, footer) comes from the promo banner inserted above <main> about a second after load. Reserve its space (a fixed-height container in the HTML), or show it in an overlay that doesn't move the page.
findings.verification_step: Rerun the plan for /: CLS should be under 0.1 on both profiles, with no shift attributed to main.

limitations: Lab data from one machine (recorded in metadata); CPU slowdown is relative to it, so another machine gives other numbers.
mobile-mid is an emulated profile, not a real phone; native apps are out of scope.
The mobile-mid diagnostic run for /order timed out on the click (tracing at 4x CPU slowdown), so there is no trace or filmstrip for that profile; the five measured runs completed.
Cold cache only; warm-cache behaviour (repeat visits) was not measured.
Firefox was measured on /about (desktop) for load timings and weight only: LCP, CLS, INP and TBT are not_supported there.
INP was measured only on /order, the one page with a scripted interaction; elsewhere it is untested and TBT is the lab proxy.
The baseline covers / and /about only, measured on the same machine an hour earlier.
Lighthouse was not run; no field data (CrUX or RUM) was provided, so field performance is not established.
next_steps: Fix the hero image first (F2): it sets LCP, the page weight and the regression from 1.0.
Fix the Add to basket handler (F3) on the ordering path, then defer and trim analytics.js (F1, F5).
Look at the menu query (F4) with the server team; Server-Timing gives the db step.
Rerun the plan after each fix on the same machine, and compare with this run as the baseline.
